'''The Yakslapper''' is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[Wroth Yakslapper]], a [[boss]] in [[Grenth's Footprint]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +10
:[[Fire damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Divine Favor]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:Reduces [[Deep Wound]] duration on you by 20% (Stacking)
:[[Enchantments]] last 20% longer
:[[Energy]] +5

==Replica==
This item cannot be replicated by using inscribable staves. The [[inscription]] "Strength of Body", which reduces [[deep wound]], can only be applied to [[shield]]s and [[focus item]]s.
* However, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
** A [[perfect]] [[staff]] drop with an [[Inherent modifier|inherent]] 20% Deep Wound reduction
** [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Enchanting]]
** [[Insightful]] [[Staff Head]]
